name: Clinical and Translational Sciences
notes: AP Biology (4/5) and IB Biology HL (6/7) earn general credit only - never major/minor requirements (encoded: apIbCreditExcluded).
UR courses must fulfill at least half the concentration requirements; ancillary-field courses are exempt (encoded: minPctFromHomeInstitution + per-group ancillary flags).
Maintain a 2.0 GPA within the major, excluding allied/ancillary field courses (minMajorGPA - informational: the app does not track grades).
Eight full-credit required courses (CTSC 299 spans two semesters), one 1-credit lab, and four electives; satisfies the natural science division of the Rochester Curriculum per the page.
Declaration requires three of PHLT 103 / STAT 180 / CHEM 203 / BIOL 198 (or 190) / BIOL 204 with a 2.0 average; S/F-graded courses cannot apply.
Transfer credit must be approved BEFORE taking courses elsewhere, including ancillary requirements.

requirementGroups.label: Foundational courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: All of the following courses: BIOL 110: Principles of Biology I; BIOL 111: Principles of Biology II; CHEM 131; CHEM 132

requirementGroups.label: Core: epidemiology, statistics, physiology
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Six of the following courses: PHLT 103: Concepts of Epidemiology; STAT 180; ... BIOL 204: Principles of Human Physiology

requirementGroups.label: Core: ethics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: PHIL 225: Medical Ethics or PHIL 228: Public Health Ethics (instructor permission required)

requirementGroups.label: Core: organic chemistry I
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: CHEM 203: Organic Chemistry I or CHEM 171: First-Year Organic Chemistry I

requirementGroups.label: Core: genetics
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: BIOL 198: Principles of Genetics or BIOL 190: Genetics: From Mendel to Molecules

requirementGroups.label: Research seminar (two semesters)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Plus both of the following: CTSC 299W: Research Seminar in Translational Sciences; CTSC 299 (CTS juniors or seniors only)

requirementGroups.label: Organic chemistry lab (1 credit)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Plus one of the following one credit labs: CHEM 207: Organic Chem I: Lab; CHEM 173: First-Year Organic Chem I Lab

requirementGroups.label: Elective: clinical research methods (1+)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Choose at least one from this group: STAT 276; CSC 161; DSCC 201 or BIOL 253; DSCC 210; PM 415U; PM 488; BST 465

requirementGroups.label: Elective: population sciences (exactly 1)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Choose only one from this group: PHLT 116; PHLT 236; PHLT 216 (valid until spring 2022); HIST 383W; PM 412; PM 414; PM 418; PM 424; PM 451; PM 489; PHLT 394E
requirementGroups.note: The choose-ONLY-one cap is honored by giving the flexible slots no population-sciences options.

requirementGroups.label: Electives: two more (clinical methods or biomedical sciences)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Students must take a total of FOUR of the following, with at least one from clinical research methods and one from population sciences. Biomedical Sciences Electives: CHEM 204 or CHEM 172; BIOL 202; BIOL 210; BIOL 222; BIOL 226; BIOL 250; MBI 220; MBI 221W

upperLevelWriting.label: ULW: CTSC 299W plus one more W course in the major
upperLevelWriting.sourceQuote: Students will be required to register for two upper-level writing courses within this major, one of which is CTSC 299W: Research Seminar in Translational Sciences.
upperLevelWriting.note: CTSC 299W is required as one of the two (also part of the seminar requirement); PM W-sections cap at five students.
